design.name: 符冻尸
design.brief: A frozen hopping vampire-corpse (僵尸) of a Taoist abbey's pilgrims, attacking in packs: a stiff little figure in a frost-covered Qing-style official robe and round hat, arms held straight out in front at shoulder height, pale blue-grey frozen skin with icicles on the sleeves and hat brim, a long yellow paper talisman pasted on its forehead with red brush runes that glows pale jade-green (weak spot), long frozen fingernails. It moves by hopping with both feet together. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four fingers; cloth shoes. Comic but creepy.
design.weapon: both arms straight out in front, mid-hop, frost trailing from its sleeves
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, paper and cloth as thick simple bands, fur as big carved clumps.
